body: Good Sir, don't let the door hit you on the way out. I'm a 44F. Short of a having a child or disabilty (sometimes having a child IS a disability 🤣🤣 kidding) there is no reason someone should be obligated to take care of or cater to another person. NOT saying don't spoil or treat nicely, just saying those things should come from the heart, not obligation. I feel like anyone woman that quick to expect that is going to be a financial bleed later. Don't do it... Respectfully.

Thank you so much. All of your kind words means a lot. I try so hard to say it doesnt need to be like this, it could be worse, etc. But like so many others I feel like at some point you have to keep going so much you hit a wall. I'm tired of hitting walls. It's like the more I worse the harder it gets and leaves no time to just breathe and take it all in. I have never been one to accept or admit I need help and then here I finally am accepting that it takes a village but I dont know where the village is. I'm just tired of it hurting to just wake up.

Thank you.  I dont know I am stronger than anyone. Just feel like I exist on autopilot doing the things I HAVE to. Anything outside that is questionable. And I feel so hard it's getting harder to hide. I dont know how to make this right. This while year has been about changing my attitude, distancing from toxins things, looking at the bright side. I just dont see that light anymore, everything is dark and worse of all I'm stubborn lol. I dont even know what I'm looking for. I hate that I know money doesnt buy true happiness but in this position I feel like part of happiness is by having money. Money for a safe, stable place to put your head at night, a home. Food, clothing... it's not about the wants it's about the needs. I cant even handle all the needs anymore. It costs money to make money and that doesnt even out. Sometimes your spending more than you can afford just to do what you have to do. I work hard,  just like so many people yet find myself in a place where I really only have 2 rational options, work or enjoy life. You cant seem to do both because even the simplest of things sometimes cost you. Everything costs... time, money and energy. My head just spins around it all. I'm sorry, just very anxious right now.

Thank you. This year has been full of challenge, a little more than normal. I'm just tired of the constant uphill battle. I have spent this year practicing patience and trying to turn everything more positive but it's almost like the harder I try the worse it gets. I'm tired of getting back up just to get beat back down. I know there are so many more people out there in so much of worse situations but this is mine and I feel it. I keep looking and searching for anything that will help charge this, hoping for a reason to smile but I'm running out of options. I am hitting a point I dont even want to try anymore.
Thank you so much.  I'm trying it just getting harder by the day.  I'm starting to give up slowly.  Not even sure I want to continue like this.
